We are looking for a talented and passionate React Native Developer with a strong foundation in native Android and/or iOS development to join our team. You will work on exciting projects across both mobile platforms, using technologies like React Native, Flutter, Kotlin, Swift, Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, and more. Requirements You have 3+ years of experience in Android and/or iOS development and 2+ years of production-level experience with React Native. You are highly proficient in JavaScript/TypeScript and have a strong understanding of asynchronous programming, the JavaScript event loop, promises, async/await, and modern state management patterns. You have hands-on experience with modern React Native architecture and best practices, including Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Context API, React Query/TanStack Query, and scalable project structures such as Clean Architecture, modular architecture, or feature-based architecture. You understand platform-specific behaviors on Android and iOS and are comfortable integrating React Native with native code using Native Modules, TurboModules, and JSI when required. You have experience working with native Android (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose) and/or native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI development) and understand how React Native integrates within hybrid or existing native applications. You are comfortable building responsive and adaptive mobile user interfaces across different screen sizes and devices, with experience optimizing layouts for phones and tablets. You have worked with RESTful APIs (including authentication flows such as OAuth and JWT), GraphQL (nice to have), third-party SDKs and payment gateways, Push notifications (Firebase Cloud Messaging / APNs). You have experience interfacing with device capabilities such as camera, media handling, GPS and geolocation services, background services and permissions, and Bluetooth/NFC (nice to have). You understand mobile app performance optimization (rendering performance, memory usage, frame drops, Flipper, Hermes profiling, Android Studio Profiler, and Xcode Instruments). You have built apps supporting offline-first functionality, local persistence (AsyncStorage, MMKV, SQLite, or Realm), and data synchronization strategies. You are familiar with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Codemagic, Fastlane, or similar tools. Automated builds and store deployment (Google Play Console, App Store Connect), code signing, and store compliance requirements You write clean, maintainable, testable code and have experience with: Unit testing (Jest) Component testing (React Native Testing Library) End-to-end testing (Detox or Maestro) You are proficient with Git-based workflows (GitFlow or trunk-based development). You understand the complete mobile development lifecycle: discovery, architecture design, development, QA, release, monitoring, and post-launch iteration. You are comfortable working in agile environments and collaborating with designers, backend engineers, QA, and product stakeholders. You demonstrate strong communication skills and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset. Nice To Have Experience with Hermes for performance optimization and debugging. Experience with Expo and the Expo ecosystem (where applicable). Familiarity with deep linking and universal/app links. Experience integrating Firebase services, including Analytics, Crashlytics, and Remote Config. Experience implementing over-the-air (OTA) updates using CodePush or Expo Updates. This job was posted by Meghana Dhamale from Ignite Solutions. Sun-Net is looking for smart, agile, intellectually curious engineers who will help us in our mission to build secure, scalable, reliable, and efficient software for our customers in the Electric Utility industry. Sun-Net's iTOA software is being used by thousands of people who deliver power on a daily basis. We are a close-knit team with a passion for improving overall user experience and are well regarded among our customers for our reliable product and excellent customer service. Sun-Net offices are located in San Jose, California by SJC, and we are starting to grow our team in India. You can look us up at: www.sunnetsoftware.com This is a unique opportunity where you can explore and implement your skills in both frontend and backend aspects of software development. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter who can collaborate with peers to solve day-to-day problems, has a passion for designing efficient algorithms and has great debugging skills. Responsibilities: You will be working with a team of talented engineers, Project Management, and get a chance to work closely with our customers to solve problems and build software that impacts daily operations of energy utilities. As a Software Engineer, you will take part in Requirement gathering, Efforts estimation, Design and Development for our enterprise product iTOA (integrated Tools for Operations Application). Technical Qualifications: 2 to 5 years of industry software engineering, software development experience Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science or related disciplines Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in object-oriented languages and database querying languages. Strong coding, debugging, algorithm design and problem-solving skills. We are currently hiring candidates with a strong knowledge of: Front-end Technologies: - Advanced JavaScript, CSS, HTML and responsive web design. - Experience with React, Angular or similar frameworks - Bonus: Knowledge of TypeScript, Webpack, LESS, SASS and Testing libraries like Chai/Mocha. Back-end Technologies: - Java, J2EE - Hibernate, JPA, Spring, Spring Boot - RESTful API, SOAP API, GraphQL - SQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server Data Structures and Algorithms: - Java Collections - Problem solving with Java - Design patterns - Time complexity - Space Complexity Bonus : Knowledge of Maven, Caching, Message Queues, Vaadin framework, Spring AI, Experience using specific MCP with AI assistants, LLM, data analytics and predictive analytics with AI. We are looking for candidates with at least 3 years of solid real-world work experience with the above technologies. You should be able to demonstrate your expertise and back your experience. Additionally, on the non-technical side, here are our expectations: Work closely with product manager, development lead and users to gather requirements and translate them into scenarios and actual code. Ability to estimate effort required to complete assigned projects/enhancements Collaborate with QA team to ensure quality of software deliverables. Effective and positive communication skills Motivation to document work and also write technical/functional specifications. Day to day work will also involve ad-hoc end-user customer support.
